_comment: Extracted from PRD dated 2026-03-04, last edited 2026-03-16
_description: AI Presence is a SaaS B2B platform (MarTech/AI Brand Intelligence) that enables PR/communications teams to monitor brand visibility across AI search engines, detect competitive gaps, and prioritize outreach targets. Phased delivery: V1 (configuration), V2 (processing + dashboard), V3 (advanced features).

functional_requirements.title: Module Activation Gate
functional_requirements.description: When user accesses the Mesure module, system checks if the module is activated for their organization. If not activated → redirect to sales page. If activated and no configuration exists → display empty state with 'Create Report' button.
acceptance_criteria: Module activation status checked on module access
Inactive orgs redirected to sales page
Active orgs with no config see empty state with create button

functional_requirements.title: Editor Login via Auth0
functional_requirements.description: Editor can log in via Auth0 and access only their organization's data
acceptance_criteria: Editor receives Auth0 token on successful login
Data access scoped to authenticated user's organization

functional_requirements.title: Reader Read-Only Access
functional_requirements.description: Reader can log in via Auth0 and access their organization's data in read-only mode
acceptance_criteria: Reader role login successful via Auth0
Reader can view all data (reports, dashboards)
Reader cannot create, edit, or delete any resources

functional_requirements.title: Organization Context Resolution
functional_requirements.description: System resolves organization context from the authenticated user's token
acceptance_criteria: Organization context extracted on every API request
Data queries filtered by organization context

functional_requirements.title: Shared Report Token-Based Access
functional_requirements.description: Unauthenticated users can access shared reports via token-based links without authentication
acceptance_criteria: Shared report links use cryptographically random tokens
Token-based access works without Auth0 authentication

functional_requirements.title: Brand Search and Selection
functional_requirements.description: Editor can search and select a brand with auto-completed suggestions (logo + domain). If no match, user can enter custom brand name.
acceptance_criteria: Real-time autocomplete returns brand name + logo/favicon + domain
Custom brand entry allowed if no match found
Selected brand persists through wizard flow

functional_requirements.title: Market Addition with Language Auto-Detection
functional_requirements.description: Editor can add multiple markets (country + language) with auto-detected language. Minimum 1 market required. Maximum enforced by quota. Duplicate pairs rejected.
acceptance_criteria: Country selection auto-fills primary official language
Language selection is overridable by user
Duplicate country+language pairs rejected with error

functional_requirements.title: Primary Market Designation
functional_requirements.description: Editor can designate one market as primary. First market added is automatically Primary. Only one Primary at a time. Primary market determines source language for category names and translations.
acceptance_criteria: Selecting another market switches Primary status
Primary market language used for translations

functional_requirements.title: AI-Based Category Discovery
functional_requirements.description: Editor can trigger AI-based category discovery for the selected brand. AI returns categories labeled 'AI GENERATED'. User can view translations per category. If AI returns 0 categories → empty state prompting to add custom category.
acceptance_criteria: Translations displayed per category per market language
Empty result shows empty state with custom add prompt
Empty category list blocks navigation to Review Prompts

functional_requirements.title: Custom Category Addition with AI Translation
functional_requirements.description: Editor can add custom categories with automatic AI translation per market language. User can manually override translations.
acceptance_criteria: Custom category labeled CUSTOM in UI
Auto-translation to all configured market languages
User can manually override translations per market

functional_requirements.title: Category Removal with Last-One Rule
functional_requirements.description: Editor can remove AI-generated or custom categories. Deletion disabled when only 1 category remains. Deletion requires confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Delete action disabled when only 1 category exists
Deletion removes category from all markets

functional_requirements.title: Review and Edit Auto-Generated Prompts
functional_requirements.description: Editor can review and edit auto-generated prompts (perception, visibility, competitive) per market and per category. Questions organized by market, then by type, then by category. 10 default questions per type per category. Auto-punctuation appends missing '?'. Empty question rejected.
acceptance_criteria: Questions organized by market → type → category
10 default questions per type per category
Inline editing of question text supported
Empty question submission rejected, restores last saved version

functional_requirements.title: Add or Remove Individual Questions
functional_requirements.description: Editor can add or remove individual questions within each prompt type. Question deletion is undoable. Question count updates in real-time. Max 20 questions per type per market (60 max per market). Beyond limit → user notified and action blocked.
acceptance_criteria: Add question action available per category section
Max 20 per type per market enforced
Limit breach notifies user and blocks action

functional_requirements.title: Reset Questions to Default
functional_requirements.description: Editor can reset questions to default per category. 'Reset' button per category restores all questions to AI-generated defaults, undoing all edits/additions/deletions for that category.

functional_requirements.title: Enable or Disable LLM Engines
functional_requirements.description: Editor can enable or disable each available LLM engine. Default engines are pre-selected. Minimum 1 engine required — if user disables all, system auto-enables all. Maximum enforced by quota.
acceptance_criteria: User can toggle each engine on/off

functional_requirements.title: Review Configuration Summary
functional_requirements.description: Editor can review a summary (markets count, categories count, total questions count) before submitting the configuration.
acceptance_criteria: Markets count, categories count, questions count shown
Reflects actual question count including user edits

functional_requirements.title: Submit Report Configuration
functional_requirements.description: Editor can submit the report configuration from the review step. On first-time configuration → analysis starts automatically. Subsequent edits are saved immediately but results produced at next scheduled weekly execution.
acceptance_criteria: Save failure results in no persistence and error message
First-time config triggers automatic analysis execution
User redirected to report page with progress display
Subsequent edits saved immediately but results delayed to weekly execution

functional_requirements.title: Quota Validation During Configuration
functional_requirements.description: System validates quotas during configuration setup. Quota brand×market validated twice: at start and at submission time. If exceeded at submission → save rejected with error. Quotas enforced: brand_market, categories, questions per type, LLMs. Warning displayed at limit. Adding disabled at limit.
acceptance_criteria: Initial quota check shows available capacity
Submission-time quota check prevents concurrent overcommit
All quota types validated: brand_market, categories, questions, LLMs
Quota exceeded → save rejected with updated usage
Warning displayed at limit, adding disabled

functional_requirements.title: Multi-LLM Parallel Analysis Execution
functional_requirements.description: System executes the analysis pipeline across all enabled LLM providers in parallel. Each enabled LLM receives all questions. Analysis produces: source classification, brand family grouping, visibility/competitive/perception metrics, competitor detection, semantic clustering, PR insights, Priority Source Targets, and Executive Summary.
acceptance_criteria: All enabled LLMs queried in parallel
All questions sent to each LLM
Source classification performed on all responses

functional_requirements.title: Structured JSON Output Validation
functional_requirements.description: System enforces structured JSON output from all LLM providers. All LLM responses must be valid JSON. Malformed responses are rejected and retried.
acceptance_criteria: All LLM responses validated as valid JSON
Automatic retry mechanism triggered for malformed responses

functional_requirements.title: Real-Time Progress Display
functional_requirements.description: System displays real-time progress during analysis execution. On first-time configuration → progress bar visible immediately. On subsequent edits → report shows PENDING status until next scheduled weekly execution.
acceptance_criteria: Progress bar displayed for first-time config
Real-time progress updates with sub-second latency
PENDING status shown for config edits
User can navigate away and return to check progress

functional_requirements.title: Graceful Degradation on LLM Provider Failure
functional_requirements.description: System continues analysis if one LLM provider fails. Report status: COMPLETED if all OK, COMPLETED_PARTIAL if some failed. FAILED only if all LLMs fail. A single LLM being down never causes FAILED.
acceptance_criteria: Failed LLM does not block analysis
Status = COMPLETED when all LLMs succeed
Status = FAILED only when all LLMs fail
Single LLM failure never causes FAILED status

functional_requirements.title: Brand Entity Normalization
functional_requirements.description: System normalizes brand entities into brand families using AI-powered grouping with domain hints. Entity name variants are grouped into single brand family. Visibility and competitive metrics aggregated by brand family. Fallback: if grouping confidence low, entity treated as own brand family.
acceptance_criteria: Entity variants grouped into brand families

functional_requirements.title: Citation Source Extraction and Deduplication
functional_requirements.description: System extracts and deduplicates citation sources from all LLM responses. All URLs cited in LLM responses are extracted and deduplicated by normalized domain. Each unique source retains attribution to which LLM(s) cited it.

functional_requirements.title: Brand and Competitor Source Classification
functional_requirements.description: System identifies brand-owned and competitor-owned sources separately. Sources matching target brand's domain tagged 'Owned'. Sources matching competitor domain tagged 'Competitor'. Classification uses domain hints from brand family grouping.
acceptance_criteria: Brand-owned sources identified by domain match
Competitor sources identified by domain match
Owned and Competitor tags applied correctly

functional_requirements.title: Brand Logo Display
functional_requirements.description: System displays brand logos using a domain-based logo service. Brand logos fetched from Brandfetch using brand's domain. Displayed in Brand Rankings tables, KPI cards, and report list. Fallback: first-letter avatar if logo unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Logo fetched from Brandfetch by domain

functional_requirements.title: Check Analysis Progress
functional_requirements.description: During analysis execution, Editor can navigate away and return to check progress. Report list shows status badge 'Processing X%'. Clicking 'View' returns to progress page.
acceptance_criteria: View button navigates back to progress page

functional_requirements.title: Auto-Translation to Market Languages
functional_requirements.description: System translates questions into each market's language automatically. Questions authored in primary market language are auto-translated to all configured market languages. User can override translations in wizard.
acceptance_criteria: Questions auto-translated to all market languages
Translations based on primary market language
User can override translations per market

functional_requirements.title: Cross-Language Category Matching
functional_requirements.description: System supports cross-language category matching (e.g., 'Solar Energy' ↔ 'Energie Solaire'). Category names entered in primary market language are matched to their translations across markets. Aggregation groups results by canonical category regardless of language.

functional_requirements.title: View Report List
functional_requirements.description: Editor can view a list of all reports for their organization with status, metadata, and date. List shows report name, status badge, creation date, number of markets, number of categories. Sorted by most recent. Supports sorting and filtering. Paginated (limit/offset). Scoped to user's organization only.
acceptance_criteria: All reports displayed with name, status, date

functional_requirements.title: Report Execution Metadata Display
functional_requirements.description: Report list displays full execution metadata: status badge with PROCESSING/COMPLETED/COMPLETED_PARTIAL/FAILED, last run date, last refresh date, execution time.
acceptance_criteria: Status badge shows: PROCESSING, COMPLETED, COMPLETED_PARTIAL, or FAILED

functional_requirements.title: Dashboard Navigation via Sidebar
functional_requirements.description: Editor can navigate between report views via sidebar (Overview, Actions Center, Category Views, Settings). Sidebar persists across all views. Active view highlighted. Category Views expandable with sub-items per category. Navigation does not reload the page (SPA).

functional_requirements.title: Market Filter
functional_requirements.description: Editor can select a market filter (Master/All Markets or individual market). Default is 'Master (All Markets)' which aggregates across all markets. Selecting a specific market scopes all KPIs, tables, and charts to that market. Filter state persists across view navigation.
acceptance_criteria: Master (All Markets) option aggregates all markets
Individual market selection filters all KPIs
Individual market filters all tables and charts

functional_requirements.title: LLM Engine Filter
functional_requirements.description: Editor can filter results by LLM engine(s) — filtering applies to all views including perception summaries and reputation topics. Multi-select LLM filter listing all active engines. Default: all active LLMs selected. Deselecting an LLM recalculates all metrics. Perception summaries regenerated. Min 1 LLM must remain selected.

functional_requirements.title: Delete Report
functional_requirements.description: Editor can delete a report. Soft delete with confirmation dialog. Deleted reports no longer appear in list. Editor role required. Shared links for deleted reports return 404.
acceptance_criteria: Shared links return 404 for deleted reports

functional_requirements.title: AI Perception Summary Generation and Caching
functional_requirements.description: System generates AI Perception Summary on-demand per filter combination at 4 hierarchical levels, and caches results. 4 levels: Global, Global per market, Per category, Per category × market. Summary = 3 bullet points (150 chars max). Loading state during generation. Cached result served on subsequent access. Cache invalidated on each new scheduled execution.
acceptance_criteria: 3 bullet points per summary (150 chars max)
Results cached per (scope, market, category, LLM selection)

functional_requirements.title: Executive Summary Generation
functional_requirements.description: System generates an Executive Summary with Areas of Improvement and scoped source recommendations. Includes structured summary with key findings, top anomalies, and recommended domains per improvement area. Displayed at top of Overview page. Generated once per analysis run.
acceptance_criteria: Executive Summary generated per analysis run

functional_requirements.title: Display 5 KPI Cards
functional_requirements.description: System displays 5 KPI cards: Share of Voice, Visibility, Avg Position, LLM Choice / Win Rate, Sentiment. Each KPI shows current value with unit. Values computed per formulas. All KPIs respect active market and LLM filters. Each KPI has quality label (Good/Fair/Poor) based on thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: 5 KPI cards displayed: SOV, Visibility, Avg Position, Win Rate, Sentiment

functional_requirements.title: Category Prioritization Matrix
functional_requirements.description: System displays Category Prioritization Matrix (SOV × Win Rate) with market flags. SOV on X-axis, Win Rate on Y-axis. 4 quadrants: Stars (high SOV + high win), Opportunity (low SOV + high win), At Risk (high SOV + low win), Monitor (low SOV + low win). Threshold: SOV 50%, Win Rate 50%.
acceptance_criteria: SOV on X-axis, Win Rate on Y-axis
4 quadrants: Stars, Opportunity, At Risk, Monitor

functional_requirements.title: Category Performance Visualization
functional_requirements.description: System displays Category Performance visualization (SOV, Competitive Wins, Perception Sentiment). One visualization per category showing 3 sub-metrics as percentages.

functional_requirements.title: Brand Rankings Table
functional_requirements.description: System displays Brand Rankings table (rank, brand with logo, SOV%, Visibility%, Avg Position, LLM Choice%). Table sorted by SOV descending. Target brand highlighted. Logo fetched from Brandfetch. Respects market/LLM filters.
acceptance_criteria: Table columns: Rank, Brand, SOV%, Visibility%, Avg Position, LLM Choice%

functional_requirements.title: Top Concepts with Sentiment Distribution
functional_requirements.description: System displays Top Concepts with sentiment distribution, frequency, and LLM attribution badges. Concepts extracted from perception responses, grouped by name. Each concept shows: frequency (% of responses), sentiment score, and LLM attribution badges. Distribution header: N positive / N negative / N neutral. List sorted by frequency descending. Expandable detail shows up to 3 quotes with source URLs and sentiment gradient.
acceptance_criteria: Expandable detail with quotes and URLs

functional_requirements.title: AI Citation Sources with Favorability
functional_requirements.description: System displays AI Citation Sources with source type breakdown and priority domain table. Stacked bar showing distribution by source type (11-category taxonomy). Clicking segment filters table. Domain table columns: Domain, Frequency, Favorability. Favorability: ≥60% green, 40-59% amber, <40% red. Expandable detail per domain: Visibility Gaps, Competitive Losses, Sentiment Issues, LLM Citations breakdown, Cited URLs list.
acceptance_criteria: Stacked bar by source type (11-category taxonomy)
Favorability color thresholds: ≥60% green, 40-59% amber, <40% red
Expandable detail per domain with gaps/losses/sentiment/citations

functional_requirements.title: Improvement Areas Detection
functional_requirements.description: System detects and displays 8 types of improvement areas with severity scoring. 8 issue types: low_visibility, poor_position, category_market_low, owned_media_gap, low_favorability, category_market_losing, low_source_favorability, negative_sentiment. Severity thresholds: Critical (metric < 25%), Warning (< 40%), Info (< 50%). Special rules: all competitive improvements cleared when global favorability >= 95%; max 3 reputation items per category. Issues detected per LLM — multiple issues if multiple LLMs show distinct problems.
acceptance_criteria: All competitive cleared when global favorability >= 95%
Sorted by severity: critical > warning > info

functional_requirements.title: Filter Areas of Improvement by Market
functional_requirements.description: Editor can filter Areas of Improvement by market/country. Market filter scopes improvement areas to the selected market. Default: all markets. Combinable with LLM filter.

functional_requirements.title: Improvement Area Detail Panel
functional_requirements.description: Editor can expand an issue to view detail panel with Quick Stats, Priority Source Targets, Owned Media, and Competitor Media sections. Expanded detail shows: Quick Stats (relevant KPIs), Priority Source Targets (domains with favorability/counts/gaps), Owned Media (brand-owned domains cited), Competitor Media (competitor domains cited).

functional_requirements.title: Priority Source Targets
functional_requirements.description: System provides Priority Source Targets with specific domains, favorability, citation counts, and gap counts. Domains listed with favorability (Favorable/Neutral/Unfavorable), total citation count, and gaps count (questions where brand underperforms). Per-LLM logo badges. Sorted by impact potential.

functional_requirements.title: Per-Category Perception Summary
functional_requirements.description: System displays per-category AI Perception Summary with key insight. Summary scoped to selected category. Shows key insight as one-sentence highlight. Generated on-demand and cached.

functional_requirements.title: Per-Category KPI Cards
functional_requirements.description: System displays per-category KPI cards (same 5 metrics scoped to category). Same 5 KPIs as FR32 but computed for selected category only. Respects market/LLM filters.

functional_requirements.title: Per-Category Brand Prioritization Matrix
functional_requirements.description: System displays per-category Brand Prioritization Matrix. Same visualization as FR33 but with brands (not categories) as data points, scoped to selected category.

functional_requirements.title: Per-Category Brand Rankings Table
functional_requirements.description: System displays per-category Brand Rankings table. Same structure as FR35 but scoped to selected category.
acceptance_criteria: Same columns and sorting as FR35

functional_requirements.title: Unified Questions Table
functional_requirements.description: System displays Unified Questions Table with visibility, competitive, and perception questions. Each row shows question text, winner/themes column, market flag, per-LLM rank badges. Favorability rules: Visibility (Won=Favorable, Split=Neutral, Lost/Not Named=Unfavorable), Competitive (Won=Favorable, Split=Neutral, Lost=Unfavorable), Perception (Positive=Favorable, Mixed=Neutral, Negative=Unfavorable). Winner column shows brand name + 'You' badge if won, competitor if agreed, 'Lost' if disagreed, 'Split' if mixed.

functional_requirements.title: Filter Questions by Favorability
functional_requirements.description: User can filter questions by favorability (favorable, split, not favorable). Filter applies to all question types in the Unified Questions Table. Default: all favorabilities shown. Filter combinable with question type filter.

functional_requirements.title: Expand Question Row for Details
functional_requirements.description: Editor can expand a question row to view full ranking, sources, and per-LLM details. Expanded detail shows: for visibility — full brand ranking list; for competitive — win/loss per LLM; for all — cited sources and full LLM response text per engine.
acceptance_criteria: Full LLM response text per engine

functional_requirements.title: Category View Scope Limitation
functional_requirements.description: Category View focuses on category-scoped metrics, rankings, questions, and citation sources — improvement areas are surfaced in Overview and Actions Center only. Category View does not display anomaly cards or improvement actions.
acceptance_criteria: Improvement areas NOT in Category View
Anomaly cards NOT in Category View
Improvement actions NOT in Category View
All improvements in Overview and Actions Center

functional_requirements.title: Per-Category Perception Topics
functional_requirements.description: System displays per-category perception topics with sentiment distribution and LLM attribution. Topic clustering with sentiment filtering (All/Positive/Mixed/Negative). LLM attribution badges per concept.

functional_requirements.title: Per-Category Perception Questions
functional_requirements.description: System displays per-category perception questions with sentiment, key themes, and per-LLM response detail. Perception questions listed in Unified Questions Table. Each row shows sentiment score, key themes, expandable per-LLM detail. Filterable by sentiment.

functional_requirements.title: Per-Category Citation Sources
functional_requirements.description: System displays per-category AI Citation Sources including reputation gaps. Citation sources table includes perception-related sources. Highlights reputation gaps (domains cited by competitors but not by the brand) within category scope.

functional_requirements.title: View Source Details
functional_requirements.description: User can view source details (URL, title, domain, LLM attribution). Accessible from any citation source in Overview (FR37) or Category View (FR49). Shows full URL, page title, normalized domain, which LLM(s) cited source.

functional_requirements.title: Add New Market to Existing Report
functional_requirements.description: Editor can add a new market to an existing report — changes take effect on next analysis run. Select country+language pair (not already in report). Config saved immediately. Quota consumed: +1 brand_market on save. New market included in next scheduled weekly execution.
acceptance_criteria: Add market action in Manage Scope
Duplicate prevention (market not already in report)

functional_requirements.title: Add New Category to Existing Report
functional_requirements.description: Editor can add a new category to an existing report — changes take effect on next analysis run. Category name + per-market translations. Config saved immediately. No additional brand_market quota consumed (category within existing markets). New category included in next scheduled weekly execution.
acceptance_criteria: Add category action in Manage Scope

functional_requirements.title: Auto-Detect Competitors
functional_requirements.description: System automatically extracts top competitors per category per market from visibility rankings — these become default entities used in competitive questions. During execution, visibility responses parsed for brand mentions. Top N brands populate competitive questions. If visibility fails for all LLMs, competitive questions use generic placeholders.
acceptance_criteria: Used as default entities in competitive questions
Fallback to generic placeholders on failure

functional_requirements.title: Manually Add Competitor
functional_requirements.description: Editor can add a competitor to an existing report — changes take effect on next analysis run. Manual competitor addition in Manage Scope. Added competitors merged with auto-detected ones. Total capped at max_competitors_per_category. Changes apply on next scheduled weekly execution.
acceptance_criteria: Manual competitor add in Manage Scope

functional_requirements.title: Persist Scope and Configuration Changes
functional_requirements.description: All scope and configuration changes (markets, categories, competitors, questions, LLMs) are persisted and automatically applied on next analysis run. Changes saved to DB immediately. No immediate re-execution. Next scheduled weekly execution uses updated config. UI shows confirmation message.

functional_requirements.title: View and Manage Markets and Categories
functional_requirements.description: Editor can view and manage the list of markets and categories for a report. Displays all markets with their categories. Markets and categories can be added or removed. Removing market/category removes associated results.
acceptance_criteria: List of all markets with categories

functional_requirements.title: Enable or Disable LLM Engines in Existing Report
functional_requirements.description: Editor can enable or disable LLM engines for an existing report — changes take effect on next analysis run. User can enable/disable each LLM engine. Min 1 engine must remain active. Changes saved immediately, applied on next scheduled weekly execution.

functional_requirements.title: Modify, Add, or Remove Questions in Existing Report
functional_requirements.description: Editor can modify, add, or remove questions on an existing report — changes take effect on next analysis run. Same editing capabilities as wizard Steps 3-4. Max 20 questions per type per market. Changes saved immediately, applied on next scheduled weekly execution.
acceptance_criteria: Question edit capability in Manage Scope

functional_requirements.title: Display Question Counts
functional_requirements.description: System displays question counts per category and market. Breakdown: N visibility + N competitive + N perception questions per category×market. Total question count for report.

functional_requirements.title: Display Analysis Metadata
functional_requirements.description: System displays analysis metadata (creation date, last analysis date, execution time). Shows creation timestamp, last successful analysis timestamp, total execution time of last run, number of runs completed.

functional_requirements.title: Automated Weekly Refresh
functional_requirements.description: System automatically refreshes all active reports on a weekly cadence. All active configurations executed weekly at same day/time as initial configuration (or last edit). Same configuration (markets, categories, questions, LLM selection). No user intervention required. Each execution produces new snapshot.

functional_requirements.title: Stagger Weekly Refreshes
functional_requirements.description: System staggers weekly refreshes to respect LLM provider rate limits. No thundering herd — refreshes queued and staggered across refresh window. Fair scheduling across tenants.

functional_requirements.title: Store Immutable Snapshots
functional_requirements.description: System stores results from each analysis run as an immutable snapshot. Each scheduled weekly execution produces new snapshot. Snapshots immutable. Minimum retention: 12 months.

functional_requirements.title: Navigate Between Snapshots
functional_requirements.description: User can navigate between analysis snapshots using previous/next controls. Navigation between snapshots with current snapshot date displayed. Viewing older snapshot updates all dashboard data to reflect that snapshot's results. No trend analysis or cross-run comparison.

functional_requirements.title: Generate Shareable Link
functional_requirements.description: Editor can generate a shareable link (token-based, no auth required) for a report. Token is cryptographically random (min 32 chars). Link format: /reports/shared/{token}. No authentication required to access. Editor can regenerate token (invalidates previous link).

functional_requirements.title: Shared Report Read-Only Access
functional_requirements.description: Shared report provides full read-only access to all views (Overview, Actions Center, Categories). All views accessible. No edit, delete, or configuration actions available. No navigation to other reports. Organisation branding preserved.

functional_requirements.title: Shared Report Market and LLM Filtering
functional_requirements.description: Shared report supports market and LLM filtering. Same filter UI as authenticated view. Filters do not modify stored data — client-side or re-query only.

functional_requirements.title: Export Report to PPTX
functional_requirements.description: Editor can export report sections to PPTX (branded slide deck with screenshots). PPTX includes: title slide, one slide per selected section with chart screenshots and key metrics. Branded with organization logo. Generation < 30s.

functional_requirements.title: Export Report to PDF
functional_requirements.description: Editor can export report to PDF via browser print dialog. Print-optimized CSS stylesheet. All visible sections included. Charts rendered as static images. No interactive elements in print view.

functional_requirements.title: Select Sections for Export
functional_requirements.description: Editor can select which sections to include in the export. User selects which sections (Overview, Actions Center, each Category). At least one section required. Selection applies to both PPTX and PDF exports.

functional_requirements.title: Send Analysis Completion Email
functional_requirements.description: System sends email notification when analysis execution completes (first-time or scheduled weekly). Email sent to all editors in organization. Includes: report name, status (COMPLETED/COMPLETED_PARTIAL), 4 KPI values, AI perception summary snippet, direct link to report. Sent within 5 minutes of completion. One email per report executed.
acceptance_criteria: Email to all editors on completion

functional_requirements.title: Send Quota Warning Email
functional_requirements.description: System sends email notification when organization quota reaches warning threshold. Warning at 80% and 100% of brand_market quota. Email includes current usage, max quota, and reset date. Sent to all editors in organization.

functional_requirements.title: Guided Tour with Demo Data
functional_requirements.description: System provides a guided tour accessible via URL parameter. Tour triggered by ?tour=true URL parameter. Tour uses demo/sample data (not real user data). Tour can be dismissed at any step. Tour state not persisted — refreshing restarts.
acceptance_criteria: Demo/sample data used (not real user data)

functional_requirements.title: Guided Tour Navigation and Tooltips
functional_requirements.description: Tour navigates automatically across views (Overview, Actions Center, Category) with contextual tooltips. Sequential steps highlighting key features: KPI cards, filters, question table, perception summary, anomalies. User can advance or skip. 8-12 steps total.
acceptance_criteria: All views covered (Overview, Actions Center, Category)

functional_requirements.title: Calculate Share of Voice
functional_requirements.description: System calculates Share of Voice as Visibility × (2 / (Avg Position + 1)). SOV expressed as percentage (0-100%). If Avg Position = 0 (not ranked), SOV = 0. Computed per category×market×LLM, then aggregated 1/N across active LLMs.

functional_requirements.title: Calculate Visibility
functional_requirements.description: System calculates Visibility as mentions / maximum possible mentions, capped at 100%. Mentions = number of visibility questions where brand appears. Max possible = total visibility questions. Visibility = mentions / max × 100, capped at 100%.
acceptance_criteria: Mentions = count of questions where brand appears

functional_requirements.title: Calculate Average Position
functional_requirements.description: System calculates Average Position as arithmetic mean of all rank positions, with penalty position 11 for unranked brands. Position extracted from ranked lists in LLM responses (1-10). Brands not mentioned receive position 11. Avg Position = sum / count. Lower is better.

functional_requirements.title: Calculate Win Rate
functional_requirements.description: System calculates LLM Choice / Win Rate as wins (target ranked #1) / total competitive questions. Win = target brand ranked #1. Win Rate = wins / total competitive questions × 100%. Computed per LLM, then aggregated 1/N.

functional_requirements.title: Calculate Sentiment
functional_requirements.description: System calculates Sentiment as weighted average of perception concept scores, weighted by frequency. Each perception concept has sentiment_score (-1.0 to +1.0) and frequency (proportion of responses). Overall Sentiment = sum(score × frequency) / sum(frequency). Displayed as score -100 to +100. Quality labels: Positive (≥ 0), Negative (< 0).

functional_requirements.title: Aggregate Master Metrics
functional_requirements.description: System aggregates Master (All Markets) metrics as arithmetic mean across all category-market pairs. Master = simple arithmetic mean of per-market values. No weighting by market size. Applied to all 4 KPIs. Displayed when market filter = 'Master (All Markets)'.

business_flows.name: First-Time Report Configuration (Sarah - PR Lead)
business_flows.description: PR lead logs in, completes onboarding wizard (brand, markets, categories, questions), submits config, and receives first analysis results within 2-6 minutes with Priority Source Targets for outreach.
steps: Editor logs in via Auth0
Module activation check passes
Empty state with Create Report button displayed
Editor enters brand name with autocomplete
Editor adds 3 markets with auto-detected languages

constraints.description: Multi-tenancy: Each organization operates in complete data isolation. No cross-organization data visibility under any circumstance.
All data in transit encrypted via TLS. Auth0 tokens validated on every API request.
LLM API keys managed server-side — never exposed to client. All LLM calls go through internal Prompt API.
Dashboard pages (Overview, Category View, Actions Center) must load within 2 seconds after analysis completion (NFR1).
Real-time progress updates during analysis must be delivered with sub-second latency from backend to UI (NFR2).
Report sharing links must load full report within 5 seconds for external stakeholders (NFR3).
PPTX export generation must complete within 30 seconds for a full report (NFR4).
System must support concurrent analysis execution across multiple organizations without degradation (NFR10).
Scheduled weekly execution queue must handle peak load (all executions simultaneous) with staggered execution (NFR11).
System must scale to support 100+ organizations with independent analysis workloads (NFR12).
Analysis execution must be idempotent — a scheduled re-execution produces identical outcome without data duplication (NFR13).
Partial LLM failure (1-2 providers down) must not block analysis completion — results delivered for available providers (NFR14).
Failed scheduled executions must be automatically retried once before alerting the user (NFR15).
No data loss on application restart — all analysis state must be persisted (NFR16).
Quota system enforces tier-based consumption limits: brand×market, categories, questions per type, LLMs. Prevents unlimited usage and cost overrun.
Analysis must complete within 2-6 minutes to meet user success criteria for 'first results' (FR success metric).
Report configuration must be completable within 10 minutes to meet success criteria (FR success metric).
GDPR compliance: ability to delete all tenant data on request (right to erasure). Data processing limited to configured markets' analysis scope (NFR9c).
V1 scope: Report configuration only (auth, wizard, quota, report list). Processing and dashboard deferred to V2.
V2 scope: Scheduled execution (weekly cron), dashboard, metrics, manage scope, notifications, export. No time evolution comparison or trend analysis.
V3 scope: Snapshot navigation (browse previous snapshots, no trend analysis) and Guided Tour. Not blocking for V2 launch.
Email service integration is provider-agnostic — swappable without code changes (SendGrid, Resend, SES, etc.) (NFR17).
All LLM calls routed through internal Prompt API. System never contacts LLM providers directly (NFR18).
If Prompt API or individual LLM providers unavailable, system degrades gracefully — affected analyses marked FAILED with automatic retry (NFR18b).

glossary.AI Presence: SaaS platform for monitoring brand perception across AI search engines
glossary.Brand Family: Group of entity name variants referring to same brand (e.g., BMW, BMW Group), grouped by AI
glossary.Brand Market: 1 brand × 1 market = 1 quota unit, fundamental billing consumption unit
glossary.Category: Product/service vertical the brand competes in (e.g., Skincare, Cloud Infrastructure)
glossary.COMPLETED_PARTIAL: Report status when some (not all) LLM providers returned results
glossary.Cross-language matching: Mapping category names across languages (e.g., Solar Energy ↔ Energie Solaire)
glossary.Executive Summary: AI-generated structured summary with key findings, top anomalies, recommended domains
glossary.LLM Choice / Win Rate: % of competitive questions where target brand ranked #1
glossary.Priority Source Targets (PST): Domains prioritized by impact — publications cited by AI engines where brand underperforms
glossary.Share of Voice (SOV): Visibility × (2 / (Avg Position + 1)) — measures presence and prominence in AI results
glossary.Snapshot: Immutable point-in-time capture of all analysis results from single execution
glossary.Source Taxonomy: 11-category classification: Corporate, Journalism, Government/NGO, Aggregator, Academic, Press Release, Review Sites, Social/UGC, Other, Owned, Competitor
glossary.Visibility: Mentions / max possible × 100%, capped at 100% — how often brand appears in AI responses
